title: Open iTerm2 in current Finder folder

rules.description: Open iTerm2 in current Finder folder (Ctrl+Option+T)

to.shell_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Finder"
if (count of windows) > 0 then
set currentFolder to POSIX path of (target of front window as alias)
else
set currentFolder to POSIX path of (path to home folder)
end if
end tell
tell application "iTerm"
activate
create window with default profile
tell current session of current window
write text "cd " & quoted form of currentFolder
end tell
end tell'
